name: Charlotte Wire & Cable Co
old_description: Charlotte Wire & Cable Company Inc. has been a trusted source for high-quality wire and cable products, with over 2,000 stock items and a combined 150,000 sq ft of warehouse and office space.
about:
Charlotte Wire & Cable Company Inc. was founded in 1993 in Concord, North Carolina, by Mike Biggers, who serves as president and founder. The company began as a wire and cable distributor committed to selling exclusively through the electrical distribution channel.

The company stocks over 2,000 wire and cable products, including building wire, utility wire, and specialized cables, across a combined 150,000 square feet of warehouse and office space. It operates as a distributor, providing 24/7 emergency service and dedicated customer support.

Charlotte Wire & Cable serves industrial and manufacturing, residential and commercial, utility and infrastructure, and logistics and transportation sectors. Its customer base consists of electrical distributors who rely on the company’s industry-specific knowledge and prompt delivery across all 50 states.

Founder Mike Biggers emphasizes the company’s “through the electrical distribution channel” sales policy as a core differentiator, aiming to provide courteous, prompt service, high-quality products, and reliable on-time delivery to distributor partners.
